description: The Austrian Photovoltaic Strategy (ÖSTERREICHISCHE PHOTOVOLTAIK-STRATEGIE) is a guiding framework dedicated to the expansion and strategic support of photovoltaics (PHOTOVOLTAIK) in Austria, providing framework, targets, and measures to support the further expansion and integration of photovoltaics.

Austria (ÖSTERREICH) has the official target of achieving climate neutrality by 2040.

The ÖSTERREICHISCHE PHOTOVOLTAIK-STRATEGIE (Austrian Photovoltaic Strategy) is a national policy instrument in Austria that is associated with the development and measures of Austria's photovoltaic (PV) market and provides guidelines for PV expansion in the country.

BETRIEBE UND UNTERNEHMEN (Austrian businesses and enterprises) are identified as stakeholders associated with PHOTOVOLTAIK (photovoltaics), and are highlighted as direct beneficiaries of PV expansion.

BAUWERKINTEGRIERTE ARCHITEKTONISCH ANGEPASSTE PHOTOVOLTAIK, also referred to as building-integrated, architecturally adapted photovoltaic (PV), is a specific form or implementation of PV-ANLAGE (PV system) that is a standard use in building applications.
The Austrian Photovoltaic Strategy (ÖSTERREICHISCHE PHOTOVOLTAIK-STRATEGIE) is applicable to Austria's national PV development and pertains to Austria's national solar policy.

The entity "FREIFLÄCHENANLAGE ALS BIODIVERSITÄTSANLAGE" (PV ground-mounted systems designed for higher biodiversity) is explicitly described as being in line with and aligning with "RENATURIERUNGSZIELE DER EU" (EU renaturation goals) when enhanced biodiversity is prioritized in their design.
